results.title: Earnings call transcript: News Corp Q3 2026 beats expectations with strong growth - Investing.com
results.content: # Earnings call transcript: News Corp Q3 2026 beats expectations with strong growth By Investing.com. # Earnings call transcript: News Corp Q3 2026 beats expectations with strong growth. Image 1: Earnings call transcript: News Corp Q3 2026 beats expectations with strong growth. News Corp reported robust earnings for the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, exceeding expectations with an EPS of $0.21, compared to the forecasted $0.19, marking a 10.53% surprise. The company’s stock showed a slight increase of 0.07% in aftermarket trading, reflecting a stable investor response to the positive financial results. News Corp continued its trend of strong performance with its 12th consecutive quarter of year-over-year growth in total segment EBITDA. The company reported a 9% increase in total revenue and an 18% rise in total segment EBITDA, driven by operational efficiency and strategic diversification. Despite challenges in the news media segment, the company remains on track for another record fiscal year of profitability.
